name: N seconds N points
summary: This EA is a scalping system that trades based on time and price movement criteria — entering positions after N seconds and targeting N points of profit. It uses a simple fixed-interval entry mechanism with quick profit-taking, designed for high-frequency short-duration trades on low-spread instruments.
summary_zh: 该EA是一个剥头皮交易系统，基于时间和价格运动条件进行交易——在N秒后入场并以N点利润为目标。它使用简单的固定时间间隔入场机制配合快速获利了结，专为低点差品种的高频短时交易设计。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念：该EA的核心思路是在特定时间间隔（N秒）后检测价格运动，当满足最小价格变动条件时入场交易。入场条件：等待N秒时间窗口结束，判断价格是否达到设定的点数阈值，若达到则顺势入场。出场条件：以固定点数（N points）作为获利目标，同时可能设有止损水平，属于快进快出的剥头皮模式。仓位管理：采用固定手数或基于账户余额的简单仓位计算方式，没有复杂的仓位管理逻辑。资金管理：缺乏严格的资金管理机制，未见到基于波动率或风险比例的动态仓位调整。整体策略逻辑简单直接，但缺乏市场结构判断和趋势过滤，容易在震荡行情中被反复止损。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept centers on detecting price movement after a specific time window (N seconds) and entering trades when a minimum price movement threshold (N points) is met. Entry conditions involve waiting for the N-second timer to elapse, then checking if price movement has reached the configured point threshold before entering in the direction of the move. Exit conditions use a fixed take-profit target of N points, embodying a quick-in-quick-out scalping approach, though stop-loss may also be present. Position sizing relies on fixed lot sizes or simple account-balance-based calculations without sophisticated position management logic. Money management lacks strict risk-based mechanisms with no dynamic position sizing based on volatility or risk percentage. The overall strategy is straightforward but lacks market structure analysis and trend filtering, making it vulnerable to repeated stop-outs in ranging markets.

parameters.description: EA魔术编号，用于标识订单

pros: 策略逻辑简单清晰，易于理解和调优
快速进出市场，减少持仓风险暴露时间
剥头皮模式下单笔亏损有限，适合小资金账户
pros_en: Strategy logic is simple and clear, easy to understand and optimize
Quick market entry and exit reduces exposure time risk
Scalping mode limits per-trade loss, suitable for small accounts
cons: 缺乏趋势过滤，在震荡行情中容易被反复止损
没有点差过滤机制，高点差环境下剥头皮可能亏损
仓位管理过于简单，未考虑波动率和风险比例
缺少新K线检查，可能在同一根K线上重复开仓
时间窗口机制过于机械，未考虑市场流动性变化
cons_en: Lacks trend filtering, vulnerable to repeated stop-outs in ranging markets
No spread filter mechanism — scalping in high-spread environments may lose money
Position sizing is overly simplistic without volatility or risk ratio consideration
Missing new bar check may cause repeated entries on the same candle
Time window mechanism is too mechanical without considering market liquidity changes
improvements: 增加趋势过滤器（如均线方向）以避免逆势交易
添加点差检查和波动率自适应的仓位管理
加入新K线检查防止同一根K线上重复开仓
improvements_en: Add a trend filter (e.g., MA direction) to avoid counter-trend trades
Implement spread checking and volatility-adaptive position sizing
Add new bar check to prevent repeated entries on the same candle

risk_points: 剥头皮策略在点差扩大时可能全部利润被吞噬
缺少新K线检查可能导致短时间重复开仓造成过度敞口
固定手数不随账户变化调整，大资金时风险放大
risk_points_en: Scalping profits can be entirely consumed when spreads widen
Missing new bar check may cause repeated entries creating excessive exposure in short time
Fixed lot sizing doesn't adjust with account size, amplifying risk for larger accounts
